complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Enhance TypeScript Definitions for Naver Maps
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the TypeScript definition enhancement for Naver Maps into subtasks covering: 1) Core map types and interfaces, 2) Marker and overlay types, 3) Event system types with generics, 4) Utility types and type guards, 5) JSDoc documentation, 6) Testing and validation
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to comprehensive API surface coverage, need for proper generic types, method overloads, and the requirement to understand the entire Naver Maps API. Requires deep TypeScript expertise and careful API documentation analysis. The task involves creating a complete type system from scratch with proper IntelliSense support.
